CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) and other AI agents when working with code in this repository.

For AI assistants helping users use sdmTMBexperiments (not work on its source), see AGENTS.md.

Package overview

sdmTMBexperiments is an R package of experimental helper functions for fitted sdmTMB models: model/mesh/survey comparison, retrospective analysis, prediction-grid construction, and diagnostic plotting. It is generic (no species/region assumptions) and doubles as a showcase and a staging ground for methods that may later be adopted into sdmTMB. Documentation: https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/

Project memory

The memory/ folder is this project’s persistent memory: purpose, architecture, naming conventions, example-data provenance, the audit trail of bug fixes, and the roadmap. Read it before starting work and keep it up to date. memory/MEMORY.md is the one-line-per-entry index — start there.

Do not put personal information into the memory files, this file, or AGENTS.md. The whole repository (including memory/) is public on GitHub. Never commit absolute local paths (/Users/<name>/...), machine-specific filenames, dataset versions tied to one computer, or contact details beyond the maintainer’s public package metadata. Use placeholders: ~/..., path/to/your/file, <your-data-folder>.

Common commands

devtools::load_all()      # load for interactive development
devtools::document()      # regenerate NAMESPACE + man/ (roxygen2)
devtools::test()          # run testthat tests
devtools::check()         # R CMD check
pkgdown::build_site()      # build the website (see Examples policy)
R CMD build .
R CMD check sdmTMBexperiments_*.tar.gz --as-cran

CI runs R CMD check (macOS/Windows/Ubuntu; devel/release/oldrel-1) and deploys the pkgdown site via .github/workflows/.

Architecture

Naming conventions (align with sdmTMB)

snake_case functions; thematic kebab-case source files; sdmTMB_-prefixed names for model-level operations (sdmTMB_retro(), sdmTMB_mesh_cv() mirror sdmTMB::sdmTMB_cv()); argument names reused from sdmTMB (bias_correct, level, area, newdata, mesh, time, offset); the parallel seed argument is future_seed everywhere. See memory/naming-conventions.md.

Shared internals (R/utils.R)

  • .setup_parallel() / .set_future_memory() — install a portable multisession plan and size future.globals.maxSize; callers restore the old plan with on.exit().
  • .safe_index() — get_index_split() with a crashed-model fallback + cv.
  • .pred_diff_base() — per-cell prediction difference between a model and a reference (carries depth when present).
  • .spatial_diff_map() — the shared ggOceanMaps spatial-difference map used by all three comparison plot() methods.
  • .safe_brewer() — palette-safe wrapper around RColorBrewer for any n.

Function families and S3 classes

  • Model selection (R/model-selection.R): sdmTMB_selection() → sdmTMB_selection (+ print/plot), built on selection_frame() (identical records), sdmTMB_cv_summary() (per-observation hold-out log-likelihood), add_aic_weights() and best_candidate() (look the winner up in the column, never by row position).
  • Comparisons return sdmTMB_model_comparison, sdmTMB_mesh_comparison, sdmTMB_survey_comparison, each with a plot() method (index / spatial, and scatter for surveys).
  • sdmTMB_retro() → sdmTMB_retro (+ plot); sdmTMB_mesh_cv() → sdmTMB_mesh_cv (+ plot).
  • mohns_rho() is the shared engine for the Mohn’s-rho annotations.
  • Grid helpers: make_survey_prediction_region() (concave hull), make_prediction_grid() (regular grid over a region), and the internal .clip_points_to_region() used by compare_surveys().
  • Plotting helpers (R/plot.R): plot_mesh(), plot_prediction_map(), plot_random_field(), plot_index(), plot_fixed_effects(), plot_variance_partitioning(), plot_prediction_histogram(), plot_residual_qq(); plus bubble_map().

Dependency policy

ggOceanMaps is a Depends (the default map tool; its bundled dd_land is only visible when attached). Heavy/optional packages are Suggests, guarded with requireNamespace(): concaveman, blockCV, inlabru, DHARMa, ggspatial, cli, ps, memuse, RColorBrewer, sdmTMBextra.

Example data

data/sebastes.rda is a public beaked-redfish subset built by data-raw/sebastes.R. See memory/example-data.md.

Provenance

Ported from project-local helpers in a redfish assessment repository, with bug fixes applied during extraction — see memory/known-fixes.md.
